The '''''Jostaar Express''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by the expert [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Raan Calrissian]]. It featured an upper gun [[Turret/Legends|turret]] and rear [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].<ref name="Tethan" /> The ship shared its name with the [[Jostaar system/Legends|Jostaar system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Tethan" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Calrissian parked the ''Jostaar Express'' in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] near local [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport's]] [[Gate 134]]<ref name="Tethan" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in the Outer Rim's [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> While Calrissian prepared to transport a shipment of [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] to a client on<ref name="Tethan" /> the Kibilini [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC Socorro">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]</ref> world<ref name="TEA" /> [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], Cloud City security subjected the ''Jostaar Express'' to an inspection before it could be cleared for departure. In the meantime, Calrissian visited one of the city's [[Hangar/Legends|loading bays]].<ref name="Tethan" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|All power to the rear defense shields. I haven't got time to label everything for you, kid. How about you get up in the gun turret and man the weapons. But don't start shooting until I give the signal! We don't want to draw attention to ourselves.|Raan Calrissian, to a youngling in an adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
The ''Jostaar Express'' appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In an adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, the [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|protagonist]], a [[Tethan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], is kidnapped by the [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Pwi'lin]] on the former's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] and taken to Cloud City to be [[Slavery/Legends|sold]] to a [[Unidentified mine owner|mine owner]]. The youngling escapes the [[Mining/Legends|mine]] owner during transportation, only to encounter Raan Calrissian at a landing bay. A local [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] then approaches the latter, to whom he indignantly inquires whether the inspection of the ''Jostaar Express'' has been concluded, not trusting the authorities to leave the vessel undamaged. After the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] responds in the affirmative, clearing the craft for departure, and leaves, Calrissian frees the Tethan from their bindings and also exits the landing bay.<ref name="Tethan" />

[[File:Cloud_City.jpg|thumb|right|250px|In ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure'', the protagonist can escape an attack on Cloud City (pictured) aboard the ''Jostaar Express''.]]
Shortly thereafter, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Bespin (Clone Wars)|attacks]] Cloud City. The youngling can then decide to search for Calrissian again to escape the city with his help. If they then join the crowds pushing to depart via the local spaceports, Calrissian spots the Tethan and brings them to the ''Jostaar Express'' to leave Cloud City before its security can close all of its spaceports. Entering the battle between the Confederacy and Cloud City security forces, Calrissian instructs the youngling to divert all of the starship's power to its rear deflector shields; however, when they hesitate due to their lack of familiarity with piloting, he instead asks them to man the [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] from the ship's gun turret. To avoid drawing attention to the ''Jostaar Express'' from the other combatants, Calrissian instructs the Tethan to not open fire until he gives the signal.<ref name="Tethan" />

The ''Jostaar Express'' then performs a series of evasive maneuvers to avoid both [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and Cloud City's [[super-cannon]]s before ultimately leaving the battle zone without firing a single shot. After their escape, Calrissian tells the youngling that they can return home to Teth, albeit noting that they must first deliver the shipment to Socorro, calling the Tethan "partner" with a grin.<ref name="Tethan" />
